core_obligations: Reduce to the case where Y = Spec(R) is affine by etale locality of the normalization (proof lines 10213-10215).
Reformulate the claim as finiteness over the Noetherian Nagata ring R of the integral closure of R in Gamma(X, O_X) (proof lines 10216-10219).
Use quasi-compactness of f to choose an affine etale U -> X and note that Gamma(X, O_X) embeds into Gamma(U, O_U) (proof lines 10219-10223).
Reduce by Noetherianity to the scheme case for U -> Y, which is finite type over a Nagata base (proof lines 10224-10228).
difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma: for a quasi-separated finite type morphism f : X -> Y of algebraic spaces over S with Y Nagata and X reduced, the normalization nu : Y' -> Y of Y in X is finite (source lines 10200-10210). The proof reduces to an affine base by etale locality of the construction, so R is a Noetherian Nagata ring and one has to show that the integral closure of R in Gamma(X, O_X) is finite over R; quasi-compactness of f makes X quasi-compact, an affine etale U -> X embeds the global sections into Gamma(U, O_U), and since R is Noetherian it suffices to know that the integral closure of R in Gamma(U, O_U) is finite, which is the scheme case for the finite type morphism U -> Y.
